summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K announcing routine disclosure of first-half 2026 financial results scheduled for July 22, 2026. The filing includes plans for analyst and media presentations with documentation posted on its website. No corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or any other special situation is involved. This is a standard periodic reporting update under Rule 13a-16 with no actionable transaction or structural change.
